title: Demonstrator vs Fault-Tolerant Stack Compiler

demonstrator.role: ideal unencoded logical layer and parameter-free witness machine
demonstrator.not_fault_tolerant_reason: single photon has fixed photon number and cannot carry a many-photon GKP grid state

fault_tolerant_machine.role: continuous-variable GKP(D4) composed with outer Steinberg code
fault_tolerant_machine.inner_code: D4 GKP lattice converts continuous displacement noise to discrete qutrit errors
fault_tolerant_machine.outer_code: [[240,81,4]]_3 Steinberg code on the 240 substrate edges

compiler_verdict: Keep the single-photon Holonet demonstrator and the fault-tolerant CV machine as separate build targets. The demonstrator tests finite logic; the fault-tolerant machine requires GKP resources and the Steinberg outer code.
boundary: Build-roadmap compiler only; not a lab bill of materials, threshold proof, or hardware performance claim.
